title: Confirm scheduled acceptance intake after the worker advances the saved request
outcome: For an idle requester, the worker can advance a newly inserted scheduled acceptance before POST confirms the exact AwaitingEvidence row. A conflict or timeout can then be reported for a durably accepted request. Confirm durable admission by the exact immutable request identity while allowing its progressed state, and verify that a declined or replaced request is never acknowledged.
acceptance: A deterministic worker/writer interleaving advances the newly saved schedule before intake acknowledgement and the response confirms the same durable request with its current state, while an absent or different request is refused.
